messages:
alex: quick brain-dump: new idea to cut ondemand spill on short preempts -> lease-proxy cutover. minimal state handoff, short resume window.

alex: basic flow: node signals reclaim, runtime mints a short-lived resume-token, emits a cutover frame with mini-checkpoint (prefix digest + last n tokens), client SDK attempts transparent resume within 25s.

mario: sounds useful, but what's the real cost win vs our graceful drain?

alex: graceful drains push many requests to ondemand or full replays. lease-proxy aims to keep most of the active request in-place via prefix access so only tail requeues. net - fewer ondemand tokens.

sophie: streaming scenarios worry me. if a chat is mid-generation with large kv, can we safely resume?

alex: plan is conservative: we only include a prefix checkpoint and allow resume if the target node is quant-compatible. otherwise force requeue. no silent quality changes.

devon: SDK impact? must be minimal for adoption.

alex: SDK gets a single control frame: "cutover:lease-proxy" with fields (resume_token, ttl, prefix_sha256). default behavior: attempt one auto-resume within ttl then fallback. we'll ship node/python helpers.

infra-bot: [alert] spot-node-us-east1-c issuing preempt notice (12s) for pool-gpu-cheapo-04

mario: race case: new node also preempted while resuming. how do we avoid double-hop replays?

alex: resume tokens tie to request-id and a prefix digest. runtime will validate digest and model-variant compatibility. if validation fails we requeue immediately. tokens are single-use.

sophie: multi-region resume? if we resume in another region latency could explode.

alex: routing rule: prefer same region only. we still emit resume_attempt_region and client chooses fallback. cross-region resumes allowed but opt-in per-app.

devon: batching: continuous batching could hold many active entries; any change there?

alex: batching layer will flush active batch on cutover, mark entries resumable and attach prefix_digest. flush overhead small, and avoids partial state races.

mario: measurement plan? we need cost-per-request delta + SLO impact.

alex: propose metrics: resume_success_rate, spill_to_ondemand_rate, extra_latency_ms, requeue_fraction. dashboards per-pool.

sophie: rollout plan? better to start on low-risk workloads.

alex: three phases: telemetry-only -> SDK opt-in beta (1%) -> alpha on cheap pools -> ramp if stable. prefer embeddings/rerank first.

devon: ops asks: node labels so tests don't collide with critical jobs and an easy feature-flag off switch.

mario: +1, include rollback runbook.

alex: security: resume-tokens are minted by control plane, KMS-signed, TTL=25s, auditable. no keys on nodes.

sophie: add a small handshake on resume to checksum prefix; protects against partial frame loss.

alex: will use sha256(prefix) in cutover frame and a micro-handshake (<5ms) on resume.

infra-bot: [info] feature-flag lease-proxy enabled for alpha pools (pool-gpu-saver-01, pool-gpu-cheapo-04)

sophie: kicking off DR and flaky-network sims now :thumbsup:

mario: please report cost delta after 72h and keep error budget tight.

alex: will post telemetry + PRs to #eng-runtime. thanks all.
